title.narrative: Operationalizing the Multilateral Mechanism and the Cali Fund (DSI)

description.narrative:
At COP15 to the Convention on Biological Diversity there was an agreement to establish a multilateral mechanism (MLM) for benefit-sharing from the use of Digital Sequence Information (DSI), including a global Fund (Decision 15/9). At COP16 the MLM and the Cali Fund were operationalized (The Cali Fund). The Fund and MLM was established to mobilize resources from the users of DSI (private sector actors) to support the Global South in their efforts to implement the goals the CBD and Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. 50% shall go to Indigenous Peoples and Local Communtities.
There are still several issues that needs to be solved to accellerate the funding from users to the Global South. This Project supports the formal negotiations through informal dialogues, technical support, capacity building, knowledge products and other activities that can add significant value in creating safe spaces for more open dialogue and creative problem solving. The end-result of this project will contribute to significantly increase financial resources for biodiversity protection in developing countries, and for indigenous peoples and local communities.
The project has a specific compontent on gender and an outcome on impementation of a gender lense on DSI.
